capacity_protocol.question: Does independent target-aware capacity justify a compositional generalization pilot?
capacity_protocol.reserved_test: four interior combinations (.30/.45,.30/.45), never used by capacity screen
capacity_protocol.input_angle: pi/8 on all 8 qubits, fixed across conditions for capacity only
capacity_protocol.initialization: same existing data_initialize on each paired training archive, all 36 parameters
capacity_protocol.selection: initial/final/scheduled/lowest validation-MMD candidates, selected solely by empirical validation TVD; population mode has analytic target access for objective/candidate generation

gate.applies_to: sampled two_block_branch seed0 across three conditions

capacity_protocol.if_pass: replicate passing capacity setup at seeds1,2; only then freeze compositional training protocol and maps without accessing reserved test distributions
capacity_protocol.if_fail: do not train shared generalization model; exact-population control diagnoses whether failure persists absent estimation noise

generalization_protocol.question: Does one shared two-block IQP model generalize to unseen interior coupling combinations under a fixed untuned map?
generalization_protocol.capacity_caveat: Seed0 gate passed; TVD replicated, but seed2 (.15,.15) connected RMSE .1316 exceeds original .10 threshold. This remains exploratory.
generalization_protocol.angle_map: alpha(c)=pi/8 - .20*pi*(c-.375)/.45; first four qubits use a, last four use b
generalization_protocol.global_flip_exclusion: Existing global encoder reads one scalar, not both condition coordinates; capacity comparator only
generalization_protocol.shared: one complete-ansatz 36-parameter unitary, no ancillas, train seed0 with sampled MMD and two-block exact-population diagnostic
generalization_protocol.training: 500 updates, 1000 train and 1000 independent validation observations per condition, batch100 per condition, 512 masks per bandwidth and 2048 model samples, existing bandwidths, Adam cosine .01 to .001, validation every25
generalization_protocol.initialization: existing data_initialize on pooled training observations, all36 params, paired across shared encoders
generalization_protocol.selection: minimum mean empirical validation TVD over all12 training conditions among initial/final/scheduled/lowest validation-MMD checkpoints; no heldout data or analytic heldout distributions until selection
generalization_protocol.bank: 12 independent sampled-MMD two-block fits at perimeter, identical angle map and per-condition settings, empirical validation TVD selection
generalization_protocol.interpolation: at interior(a,b), u=(a-.15)/.45 and v=(b-.15)/.45: one half times [(1-u)P(.15,b)+uP(.60,b)+(1-v)P(a,.15)+vP(a,.60)]
generalization_protocol.references: encoder-only, target product-of-layer-marginals diagnostic, four independent target-aware sampled-MMD two-block fits at heldout points (capacity reference, no model selection based on them)
generalization_protocol.decision: promising only if shared sampled two-block mean testTVD<=.15, worst<=.25, mean encoder-only gain>=.05, worst connectedRMSE<=.10, and mean testTVD is at least .02 lower than interpolated fitted bank. Otherwise do not recommend paper inclusion from this pilot.
generalization_protocol.if_promising: replicate shared sampled product/two-block and bank at seeds1,2 without tuning; otherwise stop
generalization_protocol.claim_scope: in-domain combinatorial interpolation at one small system size; not extrapolation, scaling, or quantum advantage

classical_diagnostics.scope: Post-hoc untuned diagnostics; same frozen interpolation formula. Empirical versions use training samples only, no validation/test samples. Symmetrization averages independent block flips. Exact-target boundary is an analytic-reference diagnostic, not a sample-budget-matched baseline. No retraining or protocol changes.

checks: paired shared model inputs and initialization
all16 target laws against scalar energies
all16 Fourier transforms against explicit parities

discarded_run: One initial shared-population diagnostic used a one-vector NumPy FWHT on a matrix. Excluded; rerun with per-condition FWHT after verification. No other changes; sampled objective unaffected.
verdict: Predeclared generalization gate passes all3 seeds, but post-hoc symmetry-aware empirical interpolation is better. Encoding is viable; do not promote current split as a demanding generalization benchmark.
artifact_scope: Exploratory outcome record; disposable runner/checkpoints deleted after capture. No canonical campaign or manuscript changes.
